data.description:
## Description
**What**: Establish the plugins/dso/docs/contracts/ directory convention with the contract schema {canonical_name, canonical_surface, semantic, producer, consumers, smoke_test}, a schema validator, the reference contract doc copy-story.md, its sibling test plugins/dso/tests/contract-copy-story.sh, and a pre-commit/CI hook that fails the build on any non-conforming contract doc.
**Why**: This is the walking skeleton every other story anchors against. The decomposer critic (draft-3) reads canonical_surface from these docs; future Epic B verifier work consumes the sibling tests. Without a machine-checkable contract record, the typo-coherence anchor has nothing to compare against.
**Scope**:
- IN: contracts directory convention; the six-field schema; a schema validator that parses each contracts/*.md and reports conformance; copy-story.md as the reference instance; the sibling contract-copy-story.sh smoke test runnable via test-batched.sh; a pre-commit/CI hook wired to fail the build on non-conforming docs.
- OUT: backfilling contract docs for already-closed epics; structured JSON payload validation (already enforced); Epic B verifier consumption of sibling tests.

## Done Definitions

- The directory plugins/dso/docs/contracts/ exists and contains copy-story.md populated with all six schema fields canonical_name, canonical_surface, semantic, producer, consumers, smoke_test ← Satisfies: sc-1
- A schema validator parses plugins/dso/docs/contracts/copy-story.md and exits zero, and exits non-zero on a doc missing any of the six fields ← Satisfies: sc-1
- The sibling test plugins/dso/tests/contract-copy-story.sh runs green via test-batched.sh ← Satisfies: sc-1
- A pre-commit/CI hook runs the schema validator over every plugins/dso/docs/contracts/*.md and fails the build when any doc is non-conforming ← Satisfies: sc-1
- Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic, including the validator's pass case and its missing-field failure case ← Satisfies: sc-1

## Considerations

- [Walking-skeleton] Every downstream story anchors against the canonical_surface field; keep the schema field names verbatim to the epic so draft-3's coherence anchor matches.
- [Self-reference] This epic modifies the plugin that plans it; the validator and hook must not break the existing pre-commit gate suite.
- [Testing] Use test-batched.sh with --runner=bash for the sibling contract test per project convention.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a DSO plugin maintainer, I want a versioned cross-skill contract directory with a schema validator and a build-failing hook, so that every signal contract doc is machine-checkable before it lands.
